test_vector_casting: test that std::vector casts to and from Python lists using pybind11 stl bindings
test_map_casting: test that std::map casts to and from Python dicts using pybind11 stl bindings
test_recursive_casting: test that nested STL containers preserve lvalue and rvalue context when casting to Python
test_optional_bindings: test that std::optional values cast to and from Python None using pybind11 stl bindings
test_variant_bindings: test that std::variant values cast to and from Python Union types using pybind11 stl bindings
